summary: Struct reset routine: reads the byte flag at offset 0x15 before the reset, then zeroes the DWORD fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0xC and 0x10, sets the DWORD at offset 0x8 to 1.0f, zeroes the byte at offset 0x14, and finally clears the flag at offset 0x15. If the flag was non-zero before the reset (previously active), ConditionalBranchByFlag is called with 1 as a deactivation notification before the flag is cleared.

operations.description: Capture the prior state of the byte flag at offset 0x15: v2 = (this[21] == 0), evaluated BEFORE any field is reset.
Set the DWORD at offset 0x8 to 1065353216, i.e. the float value 1.0f.
Zero the byte flag at offset 0x14.
When the captured flag was non-zero (v2 false), call ConditionalBranchByFlag with the constant 1 as a deactivation notification.
Clear the byte flag at offset 0x15 to 0 after the conditional notification.

Return the call result; on the path where the flag was already 0 the returned result is uninitialized (decompiler artifact). Invoked by DelegationWrapperToFUN00408280, StateInitWithGlobalConstants and CamMan_Post.
